WHAT: whisper-rs with vulkan feature flag uses whisper.cpp Vulkan backend — cross-vendor (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel), widely production-used.

HOW:
```toml
whisper-rs = { version = "0.14.3", features = ["vulkan"] }
```

BUILD REQUIREMENTS (CI only, not shipped):
- Visual Studio C++ workload + MSVC
- CMake + LLVM/clang (set LIBCLANG_PATH for bindgen)
- LunarG Vulkan SDK 1.3.x (headers + libs needed at build time only)

RUNTIME REQUIREMENTS (user machine):
- GPU drivers with Vulkan support (ships with any modern NVIDIA/AMD/Intel driver)
- VC++ 2019+ redistributable (or static-link CRT)
- NO extra DLLs to bundle

PERFORMANCE:
- NVIDIA RTX: often near-CUDA speed
- Modern AMD/Intel iGPU: 3-4x RTF improvement vs CPU
- Some AMD regression reports (RX 7600 only 1.5x RT)

GOTCHAS:
- AMD: use vulkan-radeon open-source stack, not amdvlk proprietary (causes garbage output)
- Intel Iris Xe: DeviceLostError fixed in upstream whisper.cpp patches
- Expose CPU fallback toggle in UI — Vulkan can fail on edge cases
- Vulkan slower than CUDA/OpenCL on same NVIDIA GPU in some configs
